title: Unique Ladyfinger Argentine Stir Fry
description: A unique dessert featuring ladyfingers and crunchy argentinian ingredients. A crunchy stir fry dessert.
instructions: Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Dip each ladyfinger in the unique stir fry sauce, then fry in hot oil until golden brown.
Drain the ladyfingers on a paper towel and set aside.
In a separate pan, fry the crunchy argentinian nuts in a little oil until crispy.
Mix the sugar and vanilla extract in a bowl.
Combine the drained ladyfingers and crunchy argentinian nuts in the bowl.
Pour the sugar mixture over the ladyfingers and toss until coated.
Serve the Argentine stir fry dessert immediately.
Optional: garnish with additional crunchy argentinian nuts and unique stir fry sauce.
